title: ProPublica: Inside the Memphis Chamber of Commerce's push for Elon Musk's xAI data center
why: PILO-e9ad8b, the booster side. Greater Memphis Chamber mailed Boxtown residents a postcard carrying nine agency logos and claiming xAI operated 'in full compliance'; MLGW replied the claim that it had regulatory oversight 'is in error' and TDEC confirmed it has none over supercomputing facilities. Chamber ran a five-member special operations team giving xAI 'round-the-clock concierge service,' managed its PR, and held at least 12 invitation-only meetings and no open public ones. Bobby White on a town hall: people 'being whipped into a frenzy.' Rep. Justin J. Pearson: 'the red handkerchief of the magician.' This is consent manufactured by a civic institution, the mirror of the slop farms in Vein 2.
